questions.prompt: Name two intervention types beyond adding capacity.
questions.answer: Information flows, rules, goals or delays.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.answer: To detect harms or displaced problems not captured by the target metric.
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.prompt: Does a stronger-looking structural change always work better?
questions.answer: No; its effects depend on context, implementation and system responses.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Justifies a bounded intervention using mechanisms, alternatives and guardrails.
scoring.transfer: Submit the complete system diagram with stocks, flows, signed loops, delays and an intervention comparison. Include a monitoring plan and one condition that would cause reversal.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
